source.note: 1998 Collector's Edge Advantage Football. Base is 200 cards, with #181-200 issued as late-retail box-topper update/rookie cards. Pack-issued inserts and parallels are modeled; promo/media-sample issues are excluded.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Hobby: 6 cards per pack, 18 packs per box.
decisions.baseStructure: One 200-card Base ProductSet. Cards #181-200 remain part of the collector-facing base checklist even though they were distributed as late-retail box toppers.
decisions.parallelStructure: 50-Point and Gold are partial parallels of #1-180 only. Silver is a 200-card parallel. Collector checklist boundaries are preserved rather than forced to match.
decisions.variationHandling: TCDB lists Randy Moss #196 as 196a ERR and 196b COR. VCS intentionally keeps one logical #196 card only, sourced from the corrected 196b entry. The discarded ERR/COR distinction is not surfaced in Player or Variant.
decisions.insertStructure: Pack-issued Livin' Large, Livin' Large Holofoil, Memorable Moments, Personal Victory, Prime Connection, Showtime, and Showtime Holofoil are modeled. Preview and Media Sample promotional issues are excluded.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: RC is appended only to Base subjects returned by TCDB's rookie index. Rookie status is not inferred from numbering or insert names.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean subject name plus verified RC or other short display-safe abbreviations. ERR/COR/UER, MEM, SN/PR, print-run, variation, and other descriptive metadata belong in Variant.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pricing and images are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete #1-200 collector checklist. #181-200 were late-retail box-topper update/rookie cards.

productSets.name: 50-Point
productSets.notes: Partial parallel #1-180 only; one per pack.

productSets.name: Memorable Moments

productSets.name: Personal Victory
productSets.notes: 6-card game-used football memorabilia insert, serial numbered to 200; inserted 1:675 packs.
